info.name: Load Shedding & Power Outage Management API
info.description: Run the Login requests in the 'auth' folder first - tokens and ids are saved to collection variables automatically. Seed accounts use password Password@123.

item.name: Register (customer) - sends a 6-digit OTP to the email, no token yet
Resend verification OTP (60s cooldown, max 5 per hour)
Verify email with OTP (logs the user in)

exec:
const j = pm.response.json();
if (j.data && j.data.token !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('newCustomerToken', j.data.token);
